drivers.notes: All MS-series presentation matrices share the dotted Display:Matrix:Set / Audio:Volume:Set command vocabulary. MS42 (4x2) inputs 0-3, MS52/MS52W (5x2) inputs 0-4. The MS52W adds a 4 = BYOD wireless-link input. Outputs are always 0=HDBaseT, 1=HDMI. The driver advertises the 0-4 input range; the device rejects anything it doesn't have.

AT-UHD-PRO3 series HDMI-to-HDBaseT matrix switchers. Output ranges vary by model (44M: 1-4, 66M: 1-6, 88M: 1-7+9 HDBaseT plus 8/10 HDMI mirrors, 1616M: 1-16+ mirrors). Driver state mirrors outputs 1-10. Larger 1616M outputs (11-18) accept routing commands but don't update state. Send a "Mreset" or "All#" to recover from surprising routing if a manual front-panel change happens.

Adapted from the hardware-validated Control Pro driver; the standard Control API is a documented strict subset (Chazy Control API reference, FW 1.00.17). Not yet validated against a standalone Control unit.
Telnet API confirmed against FW 1.10.11.

Verified end-to-end against live hardware (FW 1.50.02) with a live HDMI source on the TX and a display on the RX: connect, discovery, child enumeration, status parsing, enrolment/idempotency, and the operational SET surface (routing, output/mute/pause/OSD/auto, resolution, rotate, no-signal standby, HDCP/Osp SNK/SRC/OFF/H14/H22, TX encoding, LED/FPLED, audio input, IR, GPIO). OSD, mute, pause, resolution, rotation, output on/off, and a single-RX video wall tile were confirmed rendering on the attached display; the source-binding commands (video-wall class/matrix source, KVM hotkey) were accepted with a live source. Decoder video-wall mode (MODE VW) requires the RX assigned to a wall with an applied class region first. Only reboot/reset/network commands were held back on the live unit; their wire formats match the manufacturer reference. Multi-endpoint routing and multi-screen walls need additional TX/RX units to exercise.
